starting_map: make_start.py doubles the frozen k8-eight-ends T8 owners into the exact PR1074 interleaved T16 call order.
algorithm: Column generation of whole-owner capacity patterns, with one width choice per selected call, followed by integer pattern counts and literal role reconstruction. Baseline assignment columns guarantee feasibility. All final column equations are checked as integers. Exact admission is independent.

aliases.scope: Single source/helper scalar substitutions in the fixed operation order and unchanged endpoints.

adjacent_swaps.scope: Adjacent commuting B gates with fixed surrounding frames.

entrance_promotions.scope: Twelve pairs from dimension one to two and eight groups of four from dimension four to five. Each refit worsened the relaxed objective compared with the unpromoted word; this is not a proof that every promoted construction is worse than the achieved witness.

banks.scope: Floating aggregate homogeneous stage-private bank screen; geometry, actual windows, and finite admission omitted. None produced a completed supplier.

common_window_blocks.scope: Common-window intersection plus regular bipartite multigraph decomposition; limited search only.

cost_warning: search_calls.py and search_columns.py use slightly different fixed b in phi; compare the derived profile or moment root across scripts, not raw cost values.
replay: verify.py uses frozen data and byte-identical admission engines, with no solver or discovery mode.
